node_types.result: FALSE if any child is FALSE, TRUE if all are TRUE, otherwise INDETERMINATE
TRUE if any child is TRUE, FALSE if all are FALSE, otherwise INDETERMINATE

operand_types.sample_requirement: one durable sample reference from the evaluation snapshot

comparison_rules: Ordering comparisons require compatible numeric types or the same explicitly orderable scalar type.
EQ and NE compare canonical typed values; implicit string-to-number conversion is forbidden.
Tolerance is a finite nonnegative numeric scalar and is permitted only for compatible numeric EQ or NE predicates.
A missing, invalid, unacceptable-quality, stale, gapped, or clock-unacceptable sample produces INDETERMINATE under the pinned policy rather than FALSE.
NaN, infinity, type mismatch, unknown operator, and unbounded plans reject before evaluation.

quality_freshness_policy.policy_change_rule: A running evaluation retains its pinned policy revision.

atomic_sampling.unit: the same committed telemetry snapshot cursor and source-epoch set for every leaf in one evaluation attempt
atomic_sampling.tm_to_tm: Both telemetry operands resolve from the same committed snapshot cursor; each sample identity remains visible.
atomic_sampling.nested_tree: Every leaf in one attempt uses the same snapshot cursor even when Boolean short-circuiting avoids unused reads.
atomic_sampling.retry: Each retry may acquire one newer complete snapshot; samples from different attempts are never combined.
atomic_sampling.gap: A cursor gap prevents an atomic result and produces INDETERMINATE with the gap fact.

verify_options.delay: nonnegative duration before the first attempt, measured from the original durable start target
verify_options.timeout: bounded total duration including delay and retry intervals
verify_options.deadline_clock: authoritative backend monotonic deadline correlated to recorded UTC database time
verify_options.zero_retry_rule: evaluate exactly once after any delay
verify_options.deadline_rule: No attempt starts after the deadline; an attempt already holding a complete snapshot may settle against that snapshot.

result_contract.durability_rule: Any result consumed by procedure progress is durable before that progress settles.
result_contract.external_effect_rule: A v0.7 condition result cannot authorize or dispatch any external operation.

restart_rule: Resume the same ConditionPlanId, original deadline, retry budget, pinned policy, and last fully settled attempt; never extend timeout by downtime or reuse a partial attempt.
security_rules: Condition plans contain only typed operands and enumerated operators.
Catalog authorization and telemetry visibility are checked server-side for every referenced item.
Results expose only authorized sample metadata and never leak hidden item counts through cursors.
